name: Harshil Agrotech Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1972, Harshil Agrotech

keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
HAL (previously Mirchi Technologies Ltd) is in the business of preparing, manufacturing, processing, marketing, trading, import, export, improving, selling and dealing in agricultural food products like spices, oil seeds, grains, vegetables, herbs, pickles and other items derived from agricultural, farming or relevant activities

pros: Stock is trading at 0.39 times its book value
Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 99.6% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 267 days.
Working capital days have increased from 230 days to 363 days
